name: Campbeltown
method: tidetimes.org.uk Campbeltown vs its own Millport (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Millport: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: HW and LW heights each = offset + scale * Millport: Campbeltown's range is ~25% smaller. Portpatrick fits worse (19 of 547 turns over 40 min apart, none from Millport). HW scatters ~6 min. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Campbeltown vs Millport, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-25 (every 3 day(s), 547 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
